confirm.withDigest: Book gives them the part. The {{artist}} sees it in the app right away. The booking email goes out in the daily send at {{time}}.
confirm.appOnly: Book gives them the part and notifies the {{artist}} in the app right away.

accept.holdDescription: You said yes. Your {{roleProducer}} has the last word next.

actionCopy.softBookedMeaning: Said yes, waiting on you. Not booked until you book it.
actionCopy.tierConceptNote: {{Casts}} are asked in priority order. Asking starts with the first round. If it can't fill the {{showDate}}, you open the next round.
actionCopy.dateSourceNote: You can add one {{showDate}} by hand here. If your workspace syncs from Airtable, those {{showDates}} keep updating on their own, and the {{showDate}} you add here is not changed by a sync.
actionCopy.unrestrictedEligibility: This {{showDate}} has no {{cast}} limits, so anyone in {{org}} can be booked here.

cancel.title: Cancel {{artistName}}'s booking?
cancel.understudyLine: If {{artistName}} is in the main {{cast}}, the {{understudy}} who has been waiting longest and said yes moves up automatically.
cancel.whoHearsFallback: The {{artist}} is notified in the app.

timingCopy.boundsError: Enter an answer-by window of at least 1 hour, and daily send hours between 0 and 23.

scope.berlin: Daily send times include their timezone.
scope.offNote: These hours change nothing while the booking flow is off.
scope.directBookDeadFields: You book {{artists}} directly, so the answer-by window and the daily send hour change nothing.
scope.onlyConfirmationLive: Only the booking send hour is live.
scope.confirmationHourStillLive: The booking send hour still runs: it sets when booked {{artists}} are notified of schedule changes in the app.
